print_op.name: print-stage-1943
order: integer box reduce r (r=2 when a side > 8000 px, else 1)
per-frame eased 16:9 window crop, LANCZOS resample to 1280x720 (float box, PIL)

levels: v = clip((x - lo)/(hi - lo), 0, 1) with lo/hi = the asset's p0.5/p99.5 inside clean_bounds (fixed, recorded per asset), except the per-asset overrides in levels_override (04 lo 22, 01 hi 183; repair round 1, measured on the windows)
paper curve: v' = v ** gamma (one gamma for all 8)
warm silver-gelatin map: rgb = black + v' * (white - black), rounded to uint8
print_op.applies_to: every appearance of a print: rostrum assets and notebook card prints (registrar-validator/prints/<id>.png)

evidence.what_it_shows: Two conductors at the dispatcher's office counter; tall wall clock (case clock) behind them, ceiling lamp, papers on the counter.
evidence.verified_date_or_place: Chicago, Union Station; 1943 Feb. (LoC caption card); rights re-read 2026-11-16 from https://www.loc.gov/item/2017844012/?fo=json
